title: frameledger compare --json
description: The result of `frameledger compare --json`: an old set of runs against a new one; with --by-scene, each scene apart; with --base and --variant, each variant against the base. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

runs.description: The runs compared, the old set and then the new.

min_ms.description: --min-ms: the smallest change in a time that counts, in ms.

min_mb.description: --min-mb: the smallest change in memory that counts, in MB.

min_pct.description: --min-pct: the smallest change that counts, in percent of the old centre.

max_load.description: --max-load: a run whose load peak is above this was taken under load.

max_gpu_busy.description: --max-gpu-busy: a run whose GPU-busy peak, in percent, is above this was taken under load.

named_measures.description: --measure's names in the order given, a suffix included; empty without the flag.

measures.description: The measures judged, ranked by segment kind, then frame, cpu, gpu and mem, each by old centre, largest first.

unmatched.description: The measures only some runs have.

static_diff.description: The static-line keys whose values differ between the runs.

refused.description: The blocking header fields that differ. Not empty only in a refused compare, which holds runs, refused and all_frames and no measures.

all_frames.description: Whether --all-frames counted the frames a frame generator made.

reason.description: Why the scene is inconclusive or unjudged; null otherwise.

rank.description: Its place among the failing scenes, from 1; null for a scene that does not fail.

measure.description: The entry of the measure that gave the verdict, or null.

compare.description: The compare of the scene's runs; null when the scene is unjudged for lacking runs or for a file that changed after it was first read.

scenes.description: Each scene: the failing ones in rank order first.

unread.description: The files left out because they could not be read or sorted into a scene.

measures.description: The sum of the measures each of them judged.

judged.description: Counts of what was judged: measures, and with it scenes under --by-scene or variants under --base.

overrides.description: The --override flags given, as in the top-level overrides.

reason.description: Why the variant is inconclusive or unjudged; null otherwise.

rank.description: Its place by the rank measure, from 1; null when it is not ranked.

measure.description: Its entry for the rank measure, or null.

compare.description: The compare of the base's runs with the variant's; null when the variant is unjudged for a file that could not be read.

items.description: One variant, judged against the base.

variants.description: Each variant: the ranked ones in rank order, then the others by name.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

category.description: The row's category. An open set: today frame, cpu, gpu or mem.

rank_measure.description: The measure the variants are ranked by; null when no base run has it.

baseline.description: The baseline file the old or base runs came from, or null without --baseline.

result.description: One of six shapes, told apart by its keys. measures: a plain compare. scenes: --by-scene. variants: --base with --variant. refused with no measures: the runs differ in a blocking field, and it holds runs, refused and all_frames. named_measures with none of those: a --measure name is in no run; a plain compare also holds runs. {}: a file could not be read. Every shape but {} also holds baseline. The keys that tell the shapes apart are kept to their shapes: a release that adds one to another shape makes a breaking change.

compare_verdict.description: The verdict of compare: pass, fail, inconclusive, or error: a file could not be read, the runs were refused, a --measure name is in no run, or no scene or variant could be judged. A closed set.

compare_exit_code.description: The exit codes the result of compare can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.

statistic.description: How a run's frames become one value: the median or the 99th percentile, nearest-rank. A closed set.

set.description: Which labelled set a run belongs to. A closed set.

measure_verdict.description: What became of one measure: slower or faster for a time, larger or smaller for memory, noisy when the runs disagree too much to say, unchanged, or too_few when a run has too few frames for a 99th percentile. A closed set.

entry_verdict.description: The verdict on one scene or variant; unjudged when it could not be compared. A closed set.

name.description: The run's name in this result: its set and its place in it, such as old-1.

commit.description: The header's commit; null when the engine wrote it as unknown.

dirty.description: The header's dirty; null when the engine wrote it as unknown.

started_utc.description: The header's started_utc: when the run started, in UTC.

rows_dropped.description: The close line's count of rows the writer dropped; null when the run has no close line.

finished.description: Whether the run has a close line.

under_load.description: The name of each machine-load peak above its limit, load.peak then gpu_busy_pct.peak; empty for a run not taken under load.

generated_frames.description: How many of the run's frames a frame generator made.

noise.description: One entry per segment kind holding a frame/wall, in kind order, as the noisy_run warning judges the run (FLED-0072).

segment_kind.description: The segment kind; null for frames with no segment.

frames.description: How many frame/wall values the kind holds.

over_twice.description: How many of them are over twice the median.

share_pct.description: over_twice over frames, in percent to two places.

quartile_spread.description: The 75th percentile less the 25th, over the median, to three places; reported and not judged. Null when the median is 0.

judged.description: Whether noisy_run judged the kind: false under 1000 frames.

run.description: One run file that was compared.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value: it is the engine's own.

values.description: Each run's value of the field, keyed by run name.

refusal.description: One blocking header field whose values differ between the runs.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

category.description: The row's category. An open set: today frame, cpu, gpu or mem.

name.description: The row's name, as the engine wrote it.

depth.description: The row's nesting depth; 0 is the top level.

unit.description: The unit of the measure's values. An open set that follows from category: today ms, or MB for mem.

old.description: Each old run's value, in run order.

new.description: Each new run's value, in run order.

old_frames.description: Each old run's count of frames holding the measure, in run order.

new_frames.description: Each new run's count of frames holding the measure, in run order.

old_centre.description: The centre of the old runs' values.

new_centre.description: The centre of the new runs' values.

change.description: The new centre less the old centre.

change_pct.description: The change over the old centre, in percent to two places; null when the old centre is 0.

spread.description: How far the runs of a set disagree; the change is judged against it.

floor.description: The smallest change that counts for this measure, from the --min flags.

suffixed.description: True when a --measure flag named this measure's statistic with a suffix.

measure.description: One measure, judged between the two sets. Null where a result has no measure to give.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

category.description: The row's category. An open set: today frame, cpu, gpu or mem.

name.description: The row's name, as the engine wrote it.

depth.description: The row's nesting depth; 0 is the top level.

unit.description: The unit of the measure's values. An open set that follows from category: today ms, or MB for mem.

present_in.description: The names of the runs that have it.

unmatched.description: One measure that only some runs have, so it is not judged.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value: it is the engine's own.

values.description: Each run's value for the key, keyed by run name.

static_difference.description: One key of the static line whose value differs between the runs.

runs.description: The runs compared, the old set and then the new.

min_ms.description: --min-ms: the smallest change in a time that counts, in ms.

min_mb.description: --min-mb: the smallest change in memory that counts, in MB.

min_pct.description: --min-pct: the smallest change that counts, in percent of the old centre.

max_load.description: --max-load: a run whose load peak is above this was taken under load.

max_gpu_busy.description: --max-gpu-busy: a run whose GPU-busy peak, in percent, is above this was taken under load.

named_measures.description: --measure's names in the order given, a suffix included; empty without the flag.

measures.description: The measures judged, ranked by segment kind, then frame, cpu, gpu and mem, each by old centre, largest first.

unmatched.description: The measures only some runs have.

static_diff.description: The static-line keys whose values differ between the runs.

refused.description: The blocking header fields that differ. Not empty only in a refused compare, which holds runs, refused and all_frames and no measures.

all_frames.description: Whether --all-frames counted the frames a frame generator made.

comparison.description: The result of comparing one old set with one new set. Null where a scene could not be compared. A refused one holds only runs, refused and all_frames; any other holds every key.
